title: Current-feed hold expanded after workflow records escaped the keyword screen
summary: Browser QA found additional Phase 57M–Y workflow-origin records in the signal shelf. A further 215 records are temporarily excluded pending individual classification. The original 405-record cohort and one separately corrected note remain distinct; there are now 621 held records, thirteen individual classifications and 608 reviews outstanding.
evidence_note: The listed records are concrete discovery examples; the full 215-record additional scope is enumerated by screening_basis in the classification export. Origin screening is a conservative release hold, not a semantic verdict or completed review. Historical source files, publication states and URLs remain unchanged.
